# @gmod/cram (vendored)

- Package: [@gmod/cram](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@gmod/cram) v14.1.1, the
  JBrowse CRAM reader (https://github.com/GMOD/cram-js).
- Files: `cram-bundle.js` and its lazily loaded chunk `643.cram-bundle.js`, a
  browser bundle of the package, unmodified. `cram-bundle.js.LICENSE.txt`
  holds the notices the bundler collected (is-buffer, MIT).
- Licence: MIT, `LICENSE` (Copyright (c) 2017 Robert Buels).
- Loaded by `script.js` only when a CRAM file is opened (`window.gmodCRAM`).
